google.title: Setup guide · Google Drive
steps: Open console.cloud.google.com and create a project (or reuse one).
Under "APIs & Services", enable the Google Drive API for that project.
Configure the OAuth consent screen (external type; name: OpenCode Sync).
Create credentials → OAuth Client ID → type "Desktop app" and copy the Client ID.
Paste the Client ID into ~/.config/opencode/sync.json and run /sync-login.
google.note: The Client ID is public and configured once; it works on all your machines.

github.title: Setup guide · GitHub
steps: Create a private repository (for example, opencode-sessions).
Go to Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens.
Generate a token with "Contents: Read and write" limited to that repository (expires in 90 days).
Paste the token into sync.json or the OPENCODE_SYNC_TOKEN variable and run /sync-login.
github.note: No OAuth registration: paste one credential and you are done; AES-256-GCM encryption is kept.

cli.help_line: Options: --lang es|en · --provider local|github|gdrive · --github owner/repo · --gdrive · --token <pat> · --dry-run · --overwrite · --no-encrypt · --output <dir> · --from <stamp> · --parts <80mb> · delete <name> [--yes] (--owner/--repo as GitHub alternatives; --client-id/--client-secret/--refresh-token for Google Drive; setup --help for more)

delete.help:
Usage: opencode-session-sync delete <name> [--yes]
Deletes ONE local backup: <name> is the stamp/name of the copy as shown in the listing (listLocal). Without --yes it asks for confirmation (y/N). With the gdrive provider it also tries to delete the remote copy.
delete.confirm_required: Confirmation required: use --yes or run the command in an interactive terminal.

setup.q_token: GitHub token (PAT; Enter = use OPENCODE_SYNC_TOKEN or sync-auth.json):
setup.help:
Usage: opencode-session-sync setup [--github owner/repo] [--gdrive] [--token <pat>] [--provider local|github|gdrive] [--owner <user>] [--repo <repo>] [--client-id <id>] [--client-secret <secret>] [--refresh-token <token>] [--folder-name <folder>] [--parts 80mb] [--no-encrypt] [--lang es|en]
Without flags in a terminal: interactive wizard. Tokens/credentials are stored in sync-auth.json (never in sync.json) and validated against the provider API. The Google Drive refresh token also arrives via OPENCODE_GDRIVE_REFRESH.

err.passphrase: Wrong encryption passphrase or altered data (AES-256-GCM verification failed).
err.corrupt: Backup data corrupted or unrecognized format (missing OCES1 header).
err.pass_required: Backup is encrypted: passphrase missing (OPENCODE_SYNC_PASSPHRASE or sync-auth.json).
err.pass_missing: Encryption is on but there is no passphrase: run `setup` or set OPENCODE_SYNC_PASSPHRASE.
err.token_missing: GitHub token missing: set OPENCODE_SYNC_TOKEN or save it in sync-auth.json.
err.creds_missing: GitHub owner/repo missing: provide --owner and --repo or sync.json.
err.git_missing: git CLI is not available in PATH (required for the github provider).
err.auth_failed: GitHub authentication rejected (invalid token or missing Contents: Read and write permission).
err.token_invalid: Invalid GitHub token (the API responded 401). Generate a new one with Contents: Read and write.
err.repo_not_found: Repo {repo} does not exist or the token has no access to it (404).
err.no_push: The token lacks push permission on {repo} (requires Contents: Read and write).
err.part_missing: A backup part is missing: {part} (incomplete copy).
err.tar_corrupt: Backup damaged: inconsistent manifest/parts or checksum/sha256 mismatch.
err.traverse: Unsafe entry blocked (path traversal or absolute path): {entry}
err.provider_unknown: Unknown provider: {provider} (use local, github or gdrive)
err.data_missing: ⚠ OpenCode data directory does not exist: {dir}
err.config_missing: ⚠ OpenCode configuration directory does not exist: {dir}
err.gdrive_auth: Google Drive authentication rejected (check clientId/clientSecret/refreshToken; it may be revoked).
